description: This Java source file defines the MiscConverters class, which contains various converter classes for data type transformations such as Blob, Clob, String, Enum, Locale, DateFormat, Charset, UUID, and Pattern conversions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MiscConverters
classes.description: Main class providing loading of various data type converters.

classes.name: BlobToBlob
classes.description: Converts a Blob to a SerialBlob.

classes.name: BlobToByteArray
classes.description: Converts a Blob to a byte array.

classes.name: ByteArrayToBlob
classes.description: Converts a byte array to a Blob.

classes.name: ByteBufferToByteArray
classes.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a byte array.

classes.name: ByteArrayToByteBuffer
classes.description: Converts a byte array to a ByteBuffer.

classes.name: ClobToString
classes.description: Converts a Clob to a String.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: Converts an Enum to its String name.

classes.name: StringToEnumConverterCreator
classes.description: Creates converters from String to Enum.

classes.name: StringToEnum
classes.description: Converts a String to an Enum value.

classes.name: LocaleToString
classes.description: Converts a Locale to its String representation.

classes.name: StringToClob
classes.description: Converts a String to a Clob.

classes.name: StringToLocale
classes.description: Converts a String to a Locale.

classes.name: DecimalFormatToString
classes.description: Converts a DecimalFormat to its pattern String.

classes.name: StringToDecimalFormat
classes.description: Creates a DecimalFormat from a pattern String.

classes.name: SimpleDateFormatToString
classes.description: Converts a SimpleDateFormat to its pattern String.

classes.name: StringToSimpleDateFormat
classes.description: Creates a SimpleDateFormat from a pattern String.

classes.name: CharsetToString
classes.description: Converts a Charset to its name String.

classes.name: StringToCharset
classes.description: Creates a Charset from its name String.

classes.name: StringBufferToString
classes.description: Converts a StringBuffer to a String.

classes.name: StringWrapperToString
classes.description: Converts a StringWrapper to a String.

classes.name: UUIDToString
classes.description: Converts a UUID to its String representation.

classes.name: StringToUUID
classes.description: Creates a UUID from a String.

classes.name: RegexPatternToString
classes.description: Converts a Pattern to its String representation.

classes.name: StringToRegexPattern
classes.description: Creates a Pattern from a String.

classes.name: NotAConverterHelper
classes.description: Helper class that should not be loaded.

classes.name: NotAConverter
classes.description: Placeholder class not intended for conversion.

methods.description: Loads contained converters for the MiscConverters class.

methods.description: Various convert methods in inner classes performing specific data type conversions.
